text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"It hurts to admit it, but... today was a complete defeat.
I thought I'd grown stronger with you, but that girl was getting stronger too..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
To surpass my rivals,
my own dedication wasn't enough.
...That's all there is to it, right?
choice_data_list: Are you okay? You're not feeling down, are you?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Of course I'm feeling down!
No matter how much self-producing I do, it means nothing if I can't win races!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"So right now!
At least let me scream my lungs out here!
Jeez!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's so frustrating! I wanted to win!
I wanted everyone to see the "strongest" Royce-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. It's alright, I feel refreshed now.
To move forward, you have to let out your frustration first, after all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And someday, I'll laugh this shameful display off.
Yes, as just one more episode
that colors my status as the "strongest"!
choice_data_list: I have to become the 'strongest,' without a doubt.
We have to become the 'strongest,' without a doubt.
Alright, time to refocus and get back at it!
Alright, let's refocus and keep going!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I won't give up over a single defeat.
I just have to get even more serious about this.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's hurry back and rework our plan.
With today's loss,
we'll need to make some major adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Things are going to get tough from here on out, but
I'm counting on you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, fighting spirit, huh?
I love it! Wherever there's drama, there's bound
to be gritty, burning passion like that!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Royce... won't lose!
I'll definitely get stronger and bring smiles to everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Well then, let's head home.
Let's get plenty of rest so we can give it
our all again tomorrow!
